artifactWaiver.reason: Per-issue review and validation artifacts were never emitted for this wave and are unrecoverable — absent from git history, from all surviving issue worktrees, and from CI artifact retention. Producing PASS records would fabricate the evidence this gate verifies. The 18 merged diffs were reviewed against the merged code instead; seven defects were found and fixed (13e5261, 39f53a7), three of which no per-issue review could have surfaced.
